summary: Theorem4.7 has false diameter homogeneity and an impossible uniform dimension-independent rate. Core dynamics derivation has invalid intermediate steps, with conditional conclusions independently repaired. Current notebooks have evaluation defects; historical published-number consequences remain unresolved.

problems.title: The principal quantitative approximation bound is false
problems.claim: Theorem4.7 bounds uniform expected-transformer error by E+L*diam(Omega)^p*(1/(n+1)+C(p,q,d)*G), with G=n^-1/2 for p>d/2.
problems.location: PDF p6 Assumption4.3a; p7 Theorem4.7/Remark4.8; pp11-12 AppendixA equations20-21; dependencies Corollaries4.10/4.16
assumptions: Compact Omega containing0; W1-Lipschitz field; all moment classes coincide on compact domains
Exact AppendixD transformer:uniform attention,identity FC and FCout on nonnegative domain,E0
problems.check: Eq21:W1(delta0,(delta0+delta_(1/2))/2)=1/4>1/8. Exact scaling family a=1/[4(1+2C)] has actualerror a/2 and claimedbound a/4. Fixedcube quantization gives lower c(n+1)^(-1/3), c=(16*(4*pi/3))^(-1/3), exceeding claimed3/(n+1)+3C*n^-1/2 for sufficiently large n.
problems.result: No constant with the stated dependencies can satisfy the theorem. Independent exact rational and numerical bound evaluations saved.
problems.counterevidence: F^(m) varies with n in the second family, legitimately under declared constant independent of F; first family uses explicit exact nonzero transformer. Correct W1 decomposition supports qualitative convergence; finite-transformer UAT not independently certified.
problems.impact: False principal quantitative theorem, unsupported p-regularity/dimension-free interpretation and inherited corollary rate; empirical performance not refuted.
problems.correction: E+L*[D/(n+1)+sup_mu E W1(mu,empirical_n)] is valid. Finite-net argument establishes uniform empirical convergence, not printed rate.
problems.repair_verification: Correct decomposition and finite-net convergence independently derived; original rate not repaired.

problems.title: Core dynamics proof makes invalid coupling and support substitutions
problems.claim: The synchronous flow coupling cost can be replaced by optimal W1 on RHS; support proof drops initial displacement when adding inequalities.
problems.location: PDF p15 AppendixC Theorem4.14 proof; p13 PropositionB.1 supporting Theorem4.12
assumptions: Common initial law, locally Lipschitz flows, bounded-region approximation and linear growth
Uniform circle with zero field and rotation field provides coupling diagnostic
Point mass delta_R at t0 tests support intermediate inequality
problems.check: Uniform-circle rotation leaves identical marginals W1=0 but D(t)=2r*abs(sin(omega*t/2))>0. At t0 source support intermediate inequality gives2R<=R.
problems.result: Printed derivations contain false steps. Retaining D and Gronwall gives W1<=D<=epsilon*t*exp(2Lt); radius inequality yields r<=(R+1/2)exp(2Mt)-1/2<=(R+2Mt)exp(3Mt).
problems.counterevidence: These independently derived repairs preserve conditional final stability/support conclusions; no false-theorem claim for4.12/4.14. First-exit argument enforces local ball; domain evaluations assumed defined as in hypotheses.
problems.impact: Invalid core dynamical approximation derivation, assessed Major under core-proof standard despite available repair; does not alter P1 false rate.
problems.correction: Keep synchronous cost D throughout; use maximal-support-radius estimate and first-exit argument, with M+epsilon for approximation.
problems.repair_verification: Analytic conditional repair verified; diagnostic arithmetic saved.

Parameter metric is coordinate MSE, requiring sqrt(1100*v) for Frobenius. Cylindrical output ReLU excludes negative accelerations.
